Redragon H270 MENTO RGB Gaming Headset – Specifications

General

  • Compatibility: PC, Laptop, PS4 / PS5, Xbox, Mobile

Headphone

  • Driver Diameter: 50 mm

  • Frequency Response: 20 Hz – 20 kHz

  • Sensitivity: 110 ± 3 dB

Microphone

  • Type: Adjustable Boom Microphone

  • Direction: Omnidirectional

  • Frequency Response: 100 Hz – 10 kHz

  • Sensitivity: −42 ± 3 dB

Design & Features

  • Comfortable soft ear cushions

  • Adjustable headband

  • Inline controller (volume control + mic mute)

  • RGB lighting effect

  • Durable braided cable
